ctx.x: And as we taxied further on to the pier, they realized that they were bodies. And Mr. Latimore and Mr. Cook tried to find out what's the matter, and after careful attention they saw they were black bodies floating in the river.
And so they -- Cook, Latimore, went to the Captain and tried to find out. He was aware, you know. He told him what had happened were race riots with the soldiers coming in from France.
